description: Worqen Escrow — devnet deployment manifest. Canonical source for the program ID, upgrade authority, Config PDA, and keypair paths used by CI/deploy scripts and off-chain services. worqen-escrow v1.5.0 (SBPFv3 artifact; ATA-diet account lists; Anchor 1.1.2; 47 instructions).

upgrade_authority.notes: v2 deployer + upgrade authority (fresh key; original 6Ftag authority 14AZ was lost with the macOS checkout). MAINNET: Squads multisig.

config.fee_recipient_note: Dedicated devnet treasury (keypair at ~/.config/solana/worqen-treasury.json, recoverable). Set via update_config. On MAINNET use a dedicated cold/receive-only or multisig wallet.
config.allowed_mints_note: USDC (4zMMC9...) and EURC (HzwqbKZw8...) devnet mints, set via scripts/bootstrap-config.ts. SOL is always allowed. USDT has no devnet mint (alias to USDC on devnet).
config.platform_authority_note: Backend ESCROW_WALLET; pinned in Config so open_period cannot name a hostile arbitrator (v2 security fix). Set via update_config.

idl.frontend_copy: frontend/apps/dashboard/lib/solana-wallet/generated/ (codama client, regenerate via bun run generate:client)
idl.onchain_idl_note: Program Metadata Program (ProgM6JCC...) canonical 'idl' seed account, Anchor 1.x; legacy 2Y1y... closed 2026-08-17 (rent recovered). PUBLICATION PENDING: Anchor 1.1.2's chunked write plan is throttled to a truncated stream by the public devnet RPC (HTTP 429; 16+ attempts, incl. priority fees and a local throttling http proxy - the plan also needs ws subscriptions, so a plain http proxy is not enough). TO COMPLETE (2 min with any keyed RPC, e.g. free Helius/QuickNode devnet endpoint): anchor idl close <program> --provider.cluster devnet --provider.wallet ~/.config/solana/devnet-escrow.json; anchor idl init <program> -f target/idl/worqen_escrow.json --provider.cluster <keyed-rpc-url> --provider.wallet ~/.config/solana/devnet-escrow.json. Verify: anchor idl fetch -o /tmp/i.json && python: zlib.decompress(bytes.fromhex(open('/tmp/i.json').read())) parses as JSON. Clients are unaffected (codama client + vendored fixture are the sources of truth).

design.commission_model: fee-on-top: employer deposits amount + commission; the employee receives the full `amount`; commission is routed to the Config `fee_recipient` treasury (NOT the platform_authority signing key).

key_roles.config_authority: Config.authority — pause, allowlist, default fee, treasury (mainnet: multisig; two-step handoff via update_config+accept_authority)
key_roles.fee_recipient: treasury, receives all commission, never signs (cold)
key_roles.platform_authority: per-escrow hot ops key (backend): resolve disputes, force-release, auto-release

notes: Size/CU campaign: ATA-constraint diet (18 non-vault associated_token:: constraints -> owner+mint checks; 46 dead account slots removed across 10 token instructions; init_if_needed dropped on payout destinations - DESTINATION ATA CREATION IS NOW THE CALLER'S RESPONSIBILITY, backend/frontend prepend idempotent creates; treasury ATA per allowed mint must exist - bootstrap-config.ts ensures them, done on devnet: 5ViqKdpwxHabGJ8oTxWY4biG9XLdALZjkURMGmBiti5P USDC, C72ZqNq8UA6EaM6yAthirrjSfHioz1VXyyMZJJt9Ym4G EURC).

Anchor 0.32.1 -> 1.1.2: adds a built-in duplicate-mutable-account guard (new runtime error 2040), drops legacy __idl_* handlers (IDL now published via the Program Metadata Program), JS tooling moved to @anchor-lang/core.

Deployable artifact is SBPFv3 (cargo build-sbf --arch v3, platform-tools v1.55): 751,720 B vs 905,720 default-arch. Deploys REQUIRE an Agave >= 4.0.0 client; LiteSVM 1.1.0 cannot load v3, so tests run the default-arch build of identical source (16/16 E2E proven on BOTH artifacts).

Deployed bytes sha256 73ea91040ce236e8486fdcd50954... byte-identical to target/deploy-v3 (verified by dump+trim). Binary 999,496 (v1.4.0) -> 751,720 B; mainnet extend cost drops 2.0845 -> 0.3600 SOL (51,725 B still above the 700,040 B mainnet allocation).

CU: token instructions -14.5%..-40% vs v1.4.0 medians and fully deterministic (bump-search tail eliminated); deposit_sol +5.6% from the Anchor 1.x duplicate-account guard (kept deliberately as a safety invariant).

BREAKING for old clients: 10 token instructions have shorter account lists; a v1.4.0-built client misaddresses accounts. Backend/frontend on dev branches are updated; staging services must be redeployed from dev.

Legacy on-chain IDL account 2Y1y1m4c... closed with anchor-0.32.1 BEFORE the upgrade (ordering trap; rent recovered). New IDL lives at the PMP metadata account D5EDchbf...; publication fought public-RPC 429 throttling - if 'anchor idl fetch' + zlib decompress shows a truncated stream, re-run 'make idl-devnet' until complete.

Security hardening: deposit_sol/deposit_token gained the Config account at position 0 and the !paused gate (pause matrix 13 -> 15 instructions); create_escrow pins platform_authority to Config.platform_authority (6065 InvalidPlatformAuthority) and validates escrow_kind (new 6067 InvalidEscrowKind); open_period requires a platform_signer co-signature alongside the authorizer (closes the period-PDA squat).

5 callerless instructions REMOVED (52 -> 47): release_partial_sol/_token, deposit_more_sol/_token, close_unfunded_escrow_sol. close_unfunded_escrow_token kept and now built by the backend rent-close task.
Error codes 6015/6018/6032/6033/6045 retired in place as Reserved6015..Reserved6045 (numbers held, never reused); 6067 reassigned from the never-thrown VaultLeavesDust to InvalidEscrowKind.

All 28 legacy msg! sites removed; binary 1,068,168 -> 999,496 bytes (fits the existing 1,103,952-byte allocation, no extend). No account layout changes — Escrow/Config/HourlyPeriod/HourlyInvoice byte-identical.

Verified post-deploy: on-chain bytes sha256-identical to the local artifact; IDL account upgraded to 1.4.0/47 ix; live-devnet simulations confirm 6067 on unknown kind and 6065 on a foreign create_escrow arbitrator. 95/95 LiteSVM tests; 13/13 backend localnet E2E ran against identical bytecode.

BREAKING for old clients: deposits need the config account, open_period needs the platform co-signature — backend/frontend on the dev branches are updated; deployed staging services must be redeployed from dev before hourly funding or deposits will work.
approve_invoice_sol / approve_invoice_token: employer- or platform-signed instant release of a Staged hourly invoice (skips the remaining review window; gated on !config.paused; no time gate).
New event HourlyInvoiceApproved. Instruction count 50 -> 52, events 23 -> 24. No state layout changes; purely additive upgrade.
Program account extended by 80000 bytes (1023952 -> 1103952) to fit the larger binary.
On-chain IDL account initialized for the first time on this program id: 2Y1y1m4cEsNT88srWa7k3EkkHXKENT982dKNVyS64aYo.

Hourly v2: per-invoice HourlyInvoice PDAs replace the fixed [Tranche;7] array (unlimited invoices/week); money-cap HourlyPeriod v2 with hire-anchored week window (period_start_at/period_end_at); native SOL + SPL _sol/_token instruction pairs; permissionless finalize/settle/close; 50 instructions.
NEW PROGRAM ID FinhtLJ4PVBwVi8tGwWoCzN3vDpcMofBZFXFzmntGxEh (could not upgrade 6Ftag in place — original upgrade authority key was lost with the macOS checkout).

Security fixes (adversarial review): (1) Config.platform_authority pins the named platform on open_period (was vacuously authorized — squat/hostile-arbitrator DoS); (2) fund_period_sol/token gained max_fund_amount to block a raise_weekly_cap front-run; (3) native SOL vault_rent_reserve seeded on first fund so partial payouts never strand the vault below the rent-exempt minimum.
Verified: 74/74 LiteSVM tests + full backend-builder integration E2E on a live validator (identical bytecode).
ACCOUNT SCHEMA v2 — old 6Ftag hourly accounts are incompatible; this is a fresh program, no migration.
Worqen Escrow v1.0.0 — initial release (ESCROW_ACCOUNT_VERSION = 1).

New global Config PDA: mint allowlist, pause kill-switch (blocks only new create/deposit/direct-pay, never release/dispute/close), treasury fee_recipient, default commission. Instructions: init_config, update_config, accept_authority, add_allowed_mint, remove_allowed_mint.
Commission is now FEE-ON-TOP and routed to a dedicated treasury (fee_recipient), snapshotted per escrow at create — decoupled from the platform_authority signing key.
Tier-0 security fix: mandatory MINIMUM dispute window (3 days) so a worker can no longer self-dispute and instantly force-release; on-chain deadline bounded to [now+3d, now+90d].

Account additions: escrow_kind (u8), fee_recipient (Pubkey), terms_hash ([u8;32]), reserved ([u8;64]). Event additions: ref_id on EscrowReleased, fee_recipient/escrow_kind/terms_hash on EscrowCreated, ConfigUpdated + MintAllowlistChanged; DirectPaymentMade switched to fee-on-top fields.

Hardening: cancel events report actual remaining amounts; update_platform_authority rejects no-op rotation; close_unfunded_escrow_sol/_token reclaim rent on never-funded escrows; total_deposit() now returns a checked Result.

New error codes: 6034 DisputeWindowTooShort, 6035 MintNotAllowed, 6036 ProgramPaused, 6037 InvalidFeeRecipient, 6038 NoPendingAuthority, 6039 PendingAuthorityMismatch, 6040 EscrowWasFunded, 6041 MintAllowlistFull.
Built with host toolchain `stable` (repo pin 1.79.0 was too old for the dep tree); SBF program built with platform-tools 1.84.1.
Devnet smoke test green: config init, SOL escrow lifecycle with fee-on-top + treasury routing, and DisputeWindowTooShort enforcement.

Extended-flows upgrade: added deposit_more_sol/_token (top-up/retainer), batch_pay_with_commission_sol/_token (multi-recipient/team/referral), mutual_cancel_sol/_token (amicable settle, no dispute); release_partial_* now allowed in PendingRelease + employee self-draw when both confirmed. 33 instructions total. 15/15 devnet tests green.

Toolchain modernized: Agave/Solana CLI 4.0.0 (platform-tools 1.53), bun package manager + bun test, LiteSVM in-process test suite (34 tests incl. clock-warp auto-release), Cargo [lints] check-cfg. web3.js v1 retained (Anchor 0.32 client requirement).
